image_description: A close-up photograph of an orange coral fungus (Ramaria or Clavulinopsis species) growing on a decaying log. The fungus features multiple upright, cylindrical branches that fork near the tips, exhibiting a vibrant orange color with slightly paler bases. The background consists of blurred dark wood and green foliage, indicating a shallow depth of field.
